"""Fresh-process full-source checks with a direct SQLite/text/token oracle.

No sample substitution: every source row and persisted token coordinate is read.
The small set of literal/phrase queries is explicit; not a 200-gold acceptance.
"""
import argparse
import json
import platform
import shutil
import sqlite3
import time
from pathlib import Path

from pipelines.query.source_index import TOKEN, digest
from pipelines.query.source_reader import SourceIndexReader

CHARACTERS = ["I", "the", "love", "北京", "哈哈", "😀", "e\u0301", "é", "s3-no-such-phrase-20261016", "endstart"]
TOKENS = [("I",), ("the",), ("love",), ("北京",), ("。",), ("😀",), ("e\u0301",), ("é",), ("I", "am"), ("我", "爱")]


def request(unit, values):
    if unit == "character":
        pattern = {"type": "literal", "value": values}
    else:
        terms = [{"type": "term", "attr": "form", "op": "eq", "value": value} for value in values]
        pattern = terms[0] if len(terms) == 1 else {"type": "sequence", "items": terms}
    return {"dsl_version": "corpus-query/v1", "unit": unit, "within": "sentence", "pattern": pattern,
            "normalization": "none", "overlap": "all"}


def verify(database, directory, output):
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    snapshots = output / 'source'
    snapshots.mkdir()
    source_hashes = {}
    for name in ('source_index_verify.py', 'source_reader.py'):
        path = Path(__file__).with_name(name)
        shutil.copyfile(path, snapshots / name)
        source_hashes[name] = digest(path)
    started = time.monotonic()
    oracle = [{"query": request("character", v), "hits": 0, "sentences": 0, "first50": []} for v in CHARACTERS]
    oracle += [{"query": request("token", v), "hits": 0, "sentences": 0, "first50": []} for v in TOKENS]
    db = sqlite3.connect(database.resolve().as_uri() + "?mode=ro&immutable=1", uri=True)
    report = {"status": "failed", "formal_acceptance": False, "input_sha256": digest(database),
              "reader_manifest_sha256": digest(directory / "manifest.json"), "source_sha256": digest(Path(__file__)),
              "measured_source_sha256": source_hashes,
              "environment": {"platform": platform.platform(), "python": platform.python_version(),
                              "cpu_max": Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max').read_text().strip(),
                              "memory_max": Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max').read_text().strip(),
                              "shared_host": True, "cold_disk": False},
              "scope": "All source rows and all stored token coordinates; 20 explicit exact queries. No sampled index or full S3 acceptance.", "runs": []}
    try:
        with SourceIndexReader(directory, output / "runtime") as reader:
            report['index_identity_sha256'] = reader.manifest['identity_sha256']
            report['recipe_sha256'] = reader.manifest['recipe_sha256']
            observed_tokens, observed_characters = 0, 0
            for ordinal, (sid, language, text) in enumerate(db.execute("SELECT id,language,text FROM sentences ORDER BY id")):
                record = reader.record(ordinal)
                assert record[0] == sid and reader.text(ordinal) == text
                next_token = reader.record(ordinal + 1)[5] if ordinal + 1 < reader.count else reader.manifest["counts"]["tokens"]
                forms, positions, cursor = [], [], 0
                for at in range(record[5], next_token):
                    doc, start, end = TOKEN.unpack_from(reader.maps["tokens.map"], at * TOKEN.size)
                    assert doc == ordinal and cursor <= start < end <= len(text) and not text[cursor:start].strip()
                    forms.append(text[start:end])
                    positions.append((start, end))
                    cursor = end
                assert not text[cursor:].strip()
                observed_tokens += len(forms)
                observed_characters += len(text)
                for index, value in enumerate(CHARACTERS):
                    spans, at = [], 0
                    while (at := text.find(value, at)) != -1:
                        spans.append((at, at + len(value)))
                        at += 1
                    _add(oracle[index], sid, spans)
                for index, words in enumerate(TOKENS, len(CHARACTERS)):
                    spans = [(positions[i][0], positions[i + len(words) - 1][1])
                             for i in range(len(forms) - len(words) + 1) if tuple(forms[i:i + len(words)]) == words]
                    _add(oracle[index], sid, spans)
                if ordinal % 100000 == 0:
                    print(json.dumps({"stage": "independent_full_scan", "sentences": ordinal + 1}), flush=True)
            assert ordinal + 1 == reader.count
            assert observed_tokens == reader.manifest["counts"]["tokens"]
            assert observed_characters == reader.manifest["counts"]["characters"]
            report["full_mapping_check"] = {"sentences": reader.count, "tokens": observed_tokens, "characters": observed_characters}
            for expected in oracle:
                q = expected["query"]
                stamp = time.monotonic()
                page = reader.character_page(q) if q["unit"] == "character" else reader.token_page(q)
                first_page_seconds = time.monotonic() - stamp
                stamp = time.monotonic()
                counts = reader.character_counts(q) if q["unit"] == "character" else reader.token_counts(q)
                count_seconds = time.monotonic() - stamp
                assert page["total_hits"] is None and page["count_state"] == "pending"
                assert counts["total_hits"] == expected["hits"]
                assert counts["matched_segments"] == counts["matched_documents"] == expected["sentences"]
                assert [(h['source_sentence_id'], h['start'], h['end']) for h in page['page']] == expected['first50']
                for hit in page['page']:
                    text = db.execute("SELECT text FROM sentences WHERE id=?", (hit['source_sentence_id'],)).fetchone()[0]
                    assert hit['match'] == text[hit['start']:hit['end']]
                    assert hit['left'] == text[max(0,hit['start']-40):hit['start']]
                    assert hit['right'] == text[hit['end']:hit['end']+40]
                report["runs"].append({**expected, "page_seconds": first_page_seconds, "count_seconds": count_seconds,
                                       "all_counts_spans_kwic_equal": True})
                print(json.dumps({"stage": "query_checked", "unit": q["unit"], "hits": expected["hits"], "page_seconds": first_page_seconds, "count_seconds": count_seconds}), flush=True)
            report["status"] = "passed"
    finally:
        db.close()
        report["wall_seconds"] = time.monotonic() - started
        (output / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return report


def _add(entry, sid, spans):
    entry["hits"] += len(spans)
    entry["sentences"] += bool(spans)
    entry["first50"].extend((sid, left, right) for left, right in spans[:50 - len(entry["first50"])])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--database", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--index", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    verify(args.database, args.index, args.output)

"""Independent small gold plus persisted-index restart and actual CWB checks."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import shutil
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from pipelines.query.source_index import IndexBuildError, build
from pipelines.query.source_recipe import encoded
from pipelines.sources.tatoeba import RECIPE as SOURCE_RECIPE

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
HAS_ENGINE = bool(shutil.which("cwb-encode") and importlib.util.find_spec("jieba") and importlib.util.find_spec("nltk"))


def fixture(path, *, corrupt=False):
    db = sqlite3.connect(path)
    db.executescript("""CREATE TABLE metadata(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT);
      CREATE TABLE sentences(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,language TEXT,text TEXT,owner TEXT,added TEXT,modified TEXT,record_hash TEXT,text_hash TEXT,source_line INTEGER);
      CREATE TABLE edges(cmn_id INTEGER,eng_id INTEGER,PRIMARY KEY(cmn_id,eng_id));""")
    db.execute("INSERT INTO metadata VALUES('recipe',?)", (SOURCE_RECIPE,))
    for sid, lang, text in [(1,"cmn","我爱北京。哈哈哈😀"),(2,"eng","I can't go. A A A."),(3,"eng","end"),(4,"eng","start"),(5,"eng","<x> & e\u0301 😀")]:
        values = (sid,lang,text,'tester',None,None)
        db.execute("INSERT INTO sentences VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", (*values,hashlib.sha256(encoded(values)).hexdigest(),hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest() if not corrupt else '0'*64,sid))
    db.execute("INSERT INTO edges VALUES(1,2)")
    db.commit()
    db.close()


def query(unit, pattern):
    return {"dsl_version":"corpus-query/v1","unit":unit,"within":"sentence","pattern":pattern,"normalization":"none","overlap":"all"}


class MonotoneSeekTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_local_far_duplicate_and_end_seeks(self):
        from bisect import bisect_left, bisect_right

        from pipelines.query.source_reader import _monotone_bisect
        values = [0, 1, 1, 3, 8, 100, 1000, 10000]
        for value, lower in [(-1,0),(0,0),(1,0),(1,2),(7,3),(1000,1),(20000,6),(20000,8)]:
            for right in (False, True):
                with self.subTest(value=value,lower=lower,right=right):
                    expected = lower + sum(x <= value if right else x < value for x in values[lower:])
                    self.assertEqual(_monotone_bisect(values,value,lower,right=right),expected)
        for values, value, lower in [([],0,0),([0]*128+[100]*256+[1_000_000],100,128),
                                     ([0]*128+[100]*256+[1_000_000],100,257),
                                     ([1,1_000_000,2_000_000],2_000_000,1)]:
            for right in (False, True):
                expected = (bisect_right if right else bisect_left)(values,value,lower)
                self.assertEqual(_monotone_bisect(values,value,lower,right=right),expected)


@unittest.skipUnless(HAS_ENGINE, "Isolated pinned tokenizers and Linux CWB required")
class SourceIndexTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=ROOT/'tmp', prefix='index-test-')
        cls.root = Path(cls.temp.name)
        cls.source = cls.root/'source.sqlite3'
        fixture(cls.source)
        cls.result = build(cls.source,cls.root/'built','a'*64,lambda _:None)

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        cls.temp.cleanup()

    def reader(self, name):
        from pipelines.query.source_reader import SourceIndexReader
        return SourceIndexReader(self.root/'built/bundle',self.root/name)

    def test_independent_tokenization_gold(self):
        from pipelines.query.source_recipe import SurfaceTokenizer
        tokenizer = SurfaceTokenizer(self.root/'built/temporary')
        self.assertEqual(tokenizer.spans('我爱北京。', 'cmn'),[(0,1,'我'),(1,2,'爱'),(2,4,'北京'),(4,5,'。')])
        self.assertEqual(tokenizer.spans("I can't go.", 'eng'),[(0,1,'I'),(2,4,'ca'),(4,7,"n't"),(8,10,'go'),(10,11,'.')])
        self.assertEqual(tokenizer.spans('e\u0301 😀','eng'),[(0,2,'e\u0301'),(3,4,'😀')])

    def test_character_overlap_unicode_sentence_boundary(self):
        with self.reader('char-runtime') as reader:
            for value, expected in [('哈哈',[(1,5,7),(1,6,8)]),('😀',[(1,8,9),(5,13,14)]),('e\u0301',[(5,10,12)]),('é',[]),('endstart',[]),('absent',[])]:
                result=reader.character_query(query('character',{'type':'literal','value':value}))
                self.assertEqual([(h['source_sentence_id'],h['start'],h['end']) for h in result['page']],expected)
                self.assertEqual(result['total_hits'],len(expected))

    def test_character_candidate_selection_preserves_composite_spans(self):
        def literal(value):
            return {'type':'literal','value':value}
        cases = [
            (literal('北京'), [(1,2,4)]),
            (literal('哈哈'), [(1,5,7),(1,6,8)]),
            ({'type':'any_of','patterns':[literal('missing'),literal('哈哈')]}, [(1,5,7),(1,6,8)]),
            ({'type':'sequence','items':[literal('我'),{'type':'gap','min':0,'max':3},literal('北京')]}, [(1,0,4)]),
            ({'type':'sequence','items':[literal('A'),{'type':'gap','min':1,'max':3},literal('A')]}, [(2,12,15),(2,12,17),(2,14,17)]),
        ]
        with self.reader('candidate-runtime') as reader:
            for pattern, expected in cases:
                with self.subTest(pattern=pattern):
                    result = reader.character_query(query('character',pattern))
                    self.assertEqual([(h['source_sentence_id'],h['start'],h['end']) for h in result['page']],expected)
                    self.assertEqual(result['total_hits'],len(expected))
                    self.assertEqual(reader.character_page(query('character',pattern),offset=1,limit=1)['page'],result['page'][1:2])

    def test_cwb_counts_kwic_and_missing_attribute(self):
        with self.reader('token-runtime') as reader:
            q=query('token',{'type':'term','attr':'form','op':'eq','value':'A'})
            self.assertEqual(reader.token_counts(q)['total_hits'],3)
            page=reader.token_page(q)
            self.assertIsNone(page['total_hits'])
            self.assertEqual([(h['start'],h['end']) for h in page['page']],[(12,13),(14,15),(16,17)])
            # CWB implicit NFC must not merge canonically equivalent original forms.
            for form, expected in [('e\u0301',1),('é',0)]:
                exact=query('token',{'type':'term','attr':'form','op':'eq','value':form})
                self.assertEqual(reader.token_counts(exact)['total_hits'],expected)
                self.assertEqual(exact['pattern']['value'],form)
                rows=reader.token_page(exact)['page']
                self.assertEqual([(h['start'],h['end']) for h in rows],[(10,12)] if expected else [])
            q['pattern']['attr']='lemma'
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'ATTRIBUTE_UNAVAILABLE'):
                reader.token_counts(q)

    def test_fresh_process_reopens_saved_bytes(self):
        code='''import json,sys
from pipelines.query.source_reader import SourceIndexReader
from tests.query.test_source_index import query
with SourceIndexReader(sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2]) as r:
 print(json.dumps(r.character_query(query("character",{"type":"literal","value":"哈哈"}))))
'''
        result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-c',code,str(self.root/'built/bundle'),str(self.root/'fresh-runtime')],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=30)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(result.stdout)['total_hits'],2)

    def test_corrupt_input_not_indexed(self):
        source=self.root/'corrupt.sqlite3'
        fixture(source,corrupt=True)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(IndexBuildError,'INPUT_HASH_MISMATCH'):
            build(source,self.root/'corrupt','b'*64,lambda _:None)
        self.assertFalse((self.root/'corrupt/manifest.json').exists())

    def test_callback_cancel_propagates(self):
        def cancel(event):
            if event['stage']=='TOKENIZING':
                raise RuntimeError('fenced')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError,'fenced'):
            build(self.source,self.root/'cancel','b'*64,cancel)
        self.assertFalse((self.root/'cancel/manifest.json').exists())

    def test_small_quota_rejects_before_success(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(IndexBuildError,'QUOTA_EXCEEDED'):
            build(self.source,self.root/'quota','b'*64,lambda _:None,max_temporary_bytes=1)
        self.assertFalse((self.root/'quota/manifest.json').exists())

    def test_payload_corruption_rejected(self):
        from pipelines.query.source_reader import SourceIndexReader
        damaged=self.root/'damaged'
        shutil.copytree(self.root/'built/bundle',damaged)
        with (damaged/'characters.bin').open('r+b') as stream:
            stream.write(b'\xff'*8)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'HASH_MISMATCH'):
            SourceIndexReader(damaged,self.root/'damaged-runtime')

import importlib.util
import json
import shutil
import time
from pathlib import Path

from pipelines.query.source_index import digest
from pipelines.query.source_index_verify import request
from pipelines.query.source_reader import SourceIndexReader

root=Path('tmp/source-index-s3')
output=root/'reader-ab-v2-20261016'
output.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
baseline_path=root/'full-20261016/source/source_reader.py'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('baseline_reader',baseline_path)
baseline_module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(baseline_module)
new_path=Path('pipelines/query/source_reader.py')
# The saved module resolves its schema relative to __file__. Both readers must
# use the same unchanged repository schema; only this resource path is rebound.
baseline_module.__file__=str(new_path.resolve())
shutil.copyfile(new_path,output/'source_reader.py')
prior=json.loads((root/'full-20261016-fresh-verify/result.json').read_text())
report={'status':'failed','formal_acceptance':False,'configuration':{'cpu_max':Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max').read_text().strip(),'memory_max':Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max').read_text().strip(),'cold_disk':False,'shared_host':True},
        'source_sha256':{'baseline':digest(baseline_path),'optimized':digest(new_path)},
        'baseline_resource_path':'Saved baseline __file__ rebound to repository reader for identical schema resolution; algorithm unchanged.',
        'manifest_sha256':digest(root/'full-20261016/build/bundle/manifest.json'),'runs':[]}
with baseline_module.SourceIndexReader(root/'full-20261016/build/bundle',output/'old-runtime') as old, SourceIndexReader(root/'full-20261016/build/bundle',output/'new-runtime') as new:
    for iteration,order in enumerate([('baseline',old,'optimized',new),('optimized',new,'baseline',old)],1):
        for label,reader in [(order[0],order[1]),(order[2],order[3])]:
            for value,operation in [('the','count'),('e\u0301','page')]:
                q=request('character',value)

                stamp=time.monotonic()
                result=reader.character_counts(q) if operation=='count' else reader.character_page(q)
                elapsed=time.monotonic()-stamp
                if operation=='count':
                    assert result['total_hits']==expected['hits']
                    assert result['matched_segments']==result['matched_documents']==expected['sentences']
                else:
                    assert [[h['source_sentence_id'],h['start'],h['end']] for h in result['page']]==expected['first50']
                    assert result['total_hits'] is None
                row={'iteration':iteration,'reader':label,'value':value,'operation':operation,'seconds':elapsed,'result_equal':True}
                report['runs'].append(row)
                print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
report['status']='passed'
(output/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
